title: REQ · npm test runs the guard before vitest
summary: package.json test script runs the guard first so a tracked dependency fails the test run.
description: Change scripts.test from `vitest run` to `vite-node scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts && vitest run`.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, When scripts.test is read, Then it contains 'scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts' before 'vitest run'.
Given the guard exits non-zero, When chained with &&, Then vitest does not start.
technical_constraints: Guard passes only after dependency paths are untracked (npm run untrack:node-modules)
